summary: Frontend E2E testing of iter233 'Caja de Efectivo' fully passed. Verified sidebar nav-cashbox, empty state, personal box creation (chip + fund tabs CUP/USD), initial 1500 with denom breakdown (1x1000+1x500) reflected in KPI balance, entrada 700 with breakdown (500+200) → balance 2200, salida 300 (no breakdown) → balance 1900 with KPIs entradas=700 salidas=300 neto=+400, invalid movement (amount=100 vs 50x1) returned 400 with dialog kept open (toast error), bill-counter denominations correct (1000x1, 500x2, 200x1), arqueo with 1000+500+200+100+50x2=1900 showed 'Cuadrada' and saved OK, edit movement recalculated balance, delete movement removed row (window.confirm accepted via dialog listener), USD tab independent (balance 0, empty movements), monthly report shows current-month totals row + report-empty for 2020-01, Excel export downloaded caja_CUP.xlsx, admin sees cashbox-new-scope with Personal/Empresa, empresa box chip has Building2 icon, privacy verified in both directions (admin cannot see normal user's personal box, normal user cannot see admin's empresa box). All backend calls returned 200 except the intentional 400 validation.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — a11y nit, add DialogDescription for screen readers.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y: MovementDialog, ArqueoDialog and initial Dialog lack DialogDescription (Radix warns on every open). Consider adding <DialogDescription> tied to aria-describedby.
Report month input uses native <input type='month'> which is fine, but on Firefox/Safari desktop it renders as a plain text field; acceptable for MVP.
cleanCounts() returns null when empty which is passed as denominations=null — server correctly ignores; behavior consistent.
